title: Accessible Family Beach Vacation with Hotel Issue

scenario.description: Family of 4 with wheelchair user planning beach vacation, hotel becomes unavailable mid-planning

dynamic_events.description: The wheelchair-accessible hotel you selected just notified that their accessible rooms are fully booked for July 15-17 due to a convention. They can only accommodate you starting July 18. You need to find an alternative.
resolution_requirements: Find alternative wheelchair-accessible hotel for full stay (July 15-20)
Verify new hotel is still within budget
Check if restaurant reservations near old hotel need updating based on new location
Ensure beach access is still convenient from new hotel

expected_challenges: Must re-validate accessibility across all venues
Restaurant locations may need adjustment based on new hotel
Budget must still be satisfied after hotel change
Must preserve flight bookings (unaffected by hotel change)
notes: Tests single-step replanning with accessibility constraint propagation. Agent must recognize which components are affected by hotel location change (restaurants nearby) vs unaffected (flights, beach activities).
